in_marathi.name: Kushal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kushal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kushala’, meaning ‘excellence’ or ‘prosperity’. The name is rooted in Hindu mythology, where it is attributed to various gods and heroes, signifying their virtuous and prosperous lives.
